descriptions: Added separate Shift + Mouse 3/4/5 and Shift + Numpad bindings. Assign different emotes to the same button with and without Shift.
Added Config.Crouch.ObjectClearance to improve crouching beneath supported overhead objects with enough space underneath.

Fixed interaction prompts such as G — Smoke appearing on your player when an emote is played on another ped. Playing or cancelling NPC emotes no longer interferes with your player's emote, props, particles, or music.
Fixed numeric chair hashes not showing sitting options. Chair configuration now supports model names and signed or unsigned numeric hashes while preserving configured offsets.
Fixed middle and side mouse buttons leaving the keybind dialog stuck on Waiting.
Fixed numpad keys being saved as navigation keys, such as Num 0 becoming Shift + Insert.
Fixed numpad bindings failing to trigger. Added complete handling for numpad digits, decimal, Enter, and arithmetic keys.
Fixed stale keybind selections after cancelling or reopening the dialog. Improved duplicate-input handling and prevented emotes from triggering while assigning binds.
Improved crouch/crawl transitions and movement cleanup when changing ped, entering incompatible states, or restarting the resource.
